decision: Names are masked in the table and only the card's last four digits are shown
why: Ops people rarely need a full name to act; masking by default cuts accidental exposure on shared screens and in screenshots.
alternative: Show full names and PANs to anyone with the ops role.
value: Least privilege without slowing the work down: search still matches the last four.

decision: Last activity is fed by the authorization stream, not by polling the ledger
why: The auth.scored events already carry account, merchant and amount; projecting them onto rows keeps the table fresh at no extra read cost.
value: Rows flash as cards are used, and the ledger replica is left alone.

decision: Account detail opens in a drawer (?drawer=account&account=…) over the table
why: Analysts move through accounts in a list; a drawer keeps their place and filters, and the URL makes any account shareable.
alternative: A full detail page per account.
value: Faster triage, and deep links that reproduce exactly what a colleague saw.

decision: Raise limit checks the same policy v7 bands the Policies view renders, and asks for a second approver above the band
why: One policy table in code means the UI can never promise a limit the decision engine would refuse.
alternative: A free-form limit field validated later by the back office.
value: Exceptions are rare, explicit and audited.

decision: Freezing declines new authorizations but keeps existing installments running
why: Freezing is a fraud control, not a collections action; stopping installments would create delinquency the customer did not cause.
alternative: Freeze the whole account including billing.
value: Safe to freeze early on suspicion, with no collateral damage to the customer.
